subject: Cleanup nested module keyspace notifications (#12630)
reason: The change saves and restores sub->active around a module keyspace-notification callback instead of resetting it to 0. The flag is read in exactly one place, the dispatch condition (sub->active == 0 || module has REDISMODULE_OPTIONS_ALLOW_NESTED_KEYSPACE_NOTIFICATIONS). A nested re-invocation of the same subscriber, the only way prev_active can be 1, requires the ALLOW_NESTED option, and for such a module the condition short-circuits on the option and never reads active; a module without the option can never run nested, so its flag is never clobbered. The stale value is therefore unobservable:
